description: Admin panel complete build — Sprint 1 (Waitlist flow + Email Campaigns) + Sprint 2 (Quest Campaign CRUD + Analytics). Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-17-admin-panel-complete-design.md. Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-06-17-admin-sprint1-waitlist-campaigns.md

mustPassBeforePush: cd backend && pnpm build (NestJS must compile)
cd backend && pnpm test --no-coverage (all spec tests pass)
cd tasmil-finance && pnpm type-check (no TypeScript errors)

SPRINT1_PHASE_4_CONTROLLER_ENDPOINTS.description: Add two endpoints to admin.controller.ts: (1) POST admin/waitlist/bulk-send-access — @UseGuards + @Roles SUPER_ADMIN/CAMPAIGN_ADMIN, calls bulkSendAccess(dto.entryIds, req.admin.id). SPRINT1_PHASE_4_CONTROLLER_ENDPOINTS.validation: pnpm build in backend must pass. Smoke-test: curl http://localhost:6756/api/admin/waitlist/entries/test-id/dispatches with Bearer token returns [] not 404.
SPRINT1_PHASE_4_CONTROLLER_ENDPOINTS.notes: Two endpoints successfully wired to admin.controller.ts. HttpCode and HttpStatus added to @nestjs/common imports. BulkSendAccessDto, BulkSendResultDto, EmailDispatchDto added to admin.dto imports. POST /admin/waitlist/bulk-send-access with @Roles guard and @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK). GET /admin/waitlist/entries/:id/dispatches with @UseGuards. pnpm build passes without errors. All 23 admin service tests pass (bulkSendAccess and getWaitlistEntryDispatches tests included). Commit 3e710c7 on deploy/staging.

SPRINT1_PHASE_5_FRONTEND_PROXY_ROUTES.description: Create two Next.js App Router API proxy routes in tasmil-finance: (1) src/app/api/admin/waitlist/entries/[id]/dispatches/route.ts — GET handler forwards to backend /api/admin/waitlist/entries/:id/dispatches with admin Bearer token. (2) src/app/api/admin/waitlist/bulk-send-access/route.ts — POST handler forwards body to backend /api/admin/waitlist/bulk-send-access. Both use getServerBackendBaseUrl() and extract admin token from Authorization header.
SPRINT1_PHASE_5_FRONTEND_PROXY_ROUTES.validation: pnpm type-check in tasmil-finance passes with no new errors.
SPRINT1_PHASE_5_FRONTEND_PROXY_ROUTES.notes: Two proxy routes created following existing admin API route pattern. Pattern: extract Bearer token from Authorization header, validate, forward fetch request to backend with token header and original body (for POST), return backend response with same status code. getAdminToken helper reused from existing routes. Commit 9859d09 on deploy/staging. Type-check passes with only pre-existing errors unrelated to new routes.

(1) Add DTOs: CreateQuestCampaignDto (title, description, protocol, category, logoUrl, startDate, endDate, maxParticipants, isActive), QuestCampaignDto (all fields + tasks[]), CreateQuestTaskDto (title, description, type enum, pointReward, order, isActive, metadata), QuestTaskDto. Routes needed: quest-campaigns/route.ts (GET/POST), quest-campaigns/[id]/route.ts (GET/PUT/DELETE), quest-campaigns/[id]/tasks/route.ts (POST), quest-campaigns/[id]/tasks/[taskId]/route.ts (PUT/DELETE). SPRINT2_PHASE_11_QUEST_ADMIN_PROXY.validation: pnpm type-check passes. Routes compile without errors.
SPRINT2_PHASE_11_QUEST_ADMIN_PROXY.notes: Four proxy routes created in src/app/api/admin/quest-campaigns/. All follow the existing admin API route pattern: extract Bearer token from Authorization header, validate (return 401 if missing), forward fetch request to MAIN backend with token header and original body (for POST/PUT methods), return backend response with same status code.
